desc: video flowing through invisible sine currents

params.name: freq
params.help: how tight the currents run — broad swells to fine ribbons

params.name: warp
params.help: how far the picture is pushed off course; bass leans on it, highs ripple it

params.name: scroll
params.help: how fast the current flows past — 0 freezes the field in place

params.name: swirl
params.help: 0 pushes sideways only; up mixes in a crossed vertical wave until it swirls in 2D
